sources.server: StandardFlowDefinitionCatalog and the canonical field registry (V17–V38)

rules: Send every option by its code, never by its position in the list.
The server decides the next step; show the screen whose fieldId is currentStep.fieldId.
An option in exclusiveOptions stands alone: choosing it clears the other ticks.
A skipped question goes to POST …/steps/{stepId}/skip, never as a made-up answer.
